centre_north.role: Bridge Prism Tower to the northern Rouge, Jaune and Magenta context.

centre_south.role: Bridge Prism Tower to southern Bleu and Vert context, including Wild Zone 5 and Vert Plaza.

cross_policy.owner_hypothesis: The faint X/cross marks may provide map coordinates or an alignment grid because the source game map remains fixed north-up.
cross_policy.observed: Regular faint plus/cross marks repeat over the map and outside-city background.
cross_policy.use: Candidate secondary relative-alignment references after matching unique buildings, roads and canal features.
cross_policy.prior_bounded_evidence: AT343 supports one local photograph overlap only; its holdout limits remain binding.

workflow: Verify SOURCE_INTEGRITY.sha256 and create separate working copies; never process an original in place.
Use the centre/north and centre/south images as an overlap bridge, matching distinctive Prism Tower corners, road junctions and canal corners before any repeating cross pattern.
Connect the five district photograph pairs to this centre and the preserved broad overviews and Wild Zone images.
Correct camera perspective or photographed-screen tilt only on copies. Account for zoom, scale and crop differences; fixed north-up does not imply identical pixel coordinates.
Record source/crop/transform provenance and validate independent landmark holdouts inside the intended fitted region. Do not extrapolate the prior AT343 local fit across the city.
Review seams, UI masks, frame edges and sector coverage for all 48 stable sector IDs plus the existing 20 Wild Zones. Prefer another original for obscured details; never invent unseen map content.
Retain full originals and alternative detail views when selecting website derivatives. Validate any eventual map/gallery replacement on mobile and desktop before release.
